name: akukulu
description: አኩኩሉ | Akukulu — Telegram Mini App gaming platform (Ludo, Poker, Blackjack, Conquer)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @akukulu/shared && npm run build -w @akukulu/engines
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @akukulu/api && npm run build -w @akukulu/web && npm run build -w @akukulu/bot
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @akukulu/engines && npm run test -w @akukulu/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
